root.name: Ruy Lopez: Closed
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 a6 4. Ba4 Nf6 5. O-O Be7

overview: The main line is 6.Re1 b5 7.Bb3 d6 8.c3 O-O 9.h3, a slow manoeuvring fight in which White builds the c3/d4 centre and reroutes the knight via d2-f1-g3 while Black seeks counterplay with ...Na5, ...c5 and ...Bb7. Black has Breyer, Chigorin, Zaitsev and Smyslov set-ups, and White has Anti-Marshall options. The centre stays in tension and the position is slowly manoeuvring with a small White initiative. A major pillar of 1.e4 e5 theory.

white_ideas.idea: Re1, Bb3, c3 and h3 to build a d4 centre, then Nbd2-f1-g3
Press a small space edge and play d4 or d5 when ready, with kingside attacking chances

black_ideas.idea: Play ...b5, ...d6, ...O-O and ...Na5 and ...c5 to challenge d4
Use the Chigorin or Breyer rerouting to c6/b7 and attack e4

typical_structures.structure: Closed Ruy Lopez centre with White c3/d4 vs Black e5/d6 and tension in the centre

character.notes: A strategic fight with a small White initiative and Black holding well; anchor Balanced.

gambit.notes: No material is given in the main line; the Marshall is a separate sub-line.

structure.notes: Centre in tension and undecided; the taxonomy lists the Closed Ruy Lopez as Flexible.

level.notes: Deep theory, and strategically hard plans for both sides; Advanced.
